_comment: Fetched by the app on every launch. Edit, commit, push - no APK update needed.
_dataBaseUrl: Origin whose listing HTML the native home parses. If it stops working the app auto-discovers the current origin via the mirror links on homeUrl.
_authBaseUrl: The site's account service: TV sign-in codes (/device/code, /device/poll, /device/login), account status (/my-account/) and sign-out (/logout/). Used by the Premium account screen.
_nativeHome: Kill switch. false = launch straight into the WebView on homeUrl (v1.x behaviour).
_playerCss: Injected into stream pages opened from the native home. Empty = use the app's built-in default (RemoteConfig.DEFAULT_PLAYER_CSS). Only set this to hot-fix the player layout without shipping an APK; a value here overrides every app version.
_playerViewportWidth: CSS px width stream pages are laid out at in the player (desktop layout, scaled to fit). 0 = leave the site's own viewport.
_directPlayer: WebView player only (nativePlayer=false or native fallback): true = resolve the stream page to its inner video player and show that full screen with autoplay; false = show the site's stream page with server tabs.
_nativePlayer: true = play streams with the built-in player (ExoPlayer: server switching with Left/Right, HUD, automatic fallback). false = the WebView player (v2.x behaviour). The native player falls back to the WebView by itself when it cannot extract a playlist.
_parser: Site markup rules. Every key is optional and overrides the app's built-in default (see ParserRules.java for the full list and defaults). Regexes use Java syntax with group 1 as the value. Use this when the site changes its HTML and the home screen or player stop working. Example: {"cardStart": "<(?:div|a)\\s+class=\"m-card\\b([^\"]*)\"([^>]*)>", "statusPath": "/data/espn_status_batch.json", "serverItem": "...", "hlsUrl": "..."}
